# Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

We as creator, maintainer, and community participants pledge to make participation in **Cosmogonic Quantum Mechalogodrom 2 (`CQM2`)** a harassment-free, intellectually rigorous, and welcoming experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, visible or invisible disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of experience, education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, caste, color, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

We pledge to act and interact in ways that contribute to an open, honest, scientific, and respectful research community.

## Our Standards

Examples of behavior that contributes to a positive environment include:

- Demonstrating empathy, intellectual honesty, and respect toward other researchers and users
- Distinguishing mathematical models and computational indicators (`indicatorOnly`) from claims of phenomenal consciousness
- Giving and gracefully accepting constructive technical feedback and reproducible bug reports
- Focusing on empirical evidence, conservation invariants, and verifiable benchmarks

Examples of unacceptable behavior include:

- The use of sexualized language or imagery, and sexual attention or advances of any kind
- Trolling, insulting or derogatory comments, and personal or political attacks
- Public or private harassment, doxxing, or publishing others' private information without explicit permission
- Misrepresenting authorship, stripping license attributions, or violating the non-commercial terms of `LICENSE`

## Enforcement Responsibilities

Project leadership (`0thernes LLC`) is responsible for clarifying and enforcing standards of acceptable behavior and will take appropriate and fair corrective action in response to any behavior deemed inappropriate, threatening, offensive, or harmful.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies within all project spaces (GitHub Issues, Releases, and official communication channels) and applies when an individual is officially representing the project.

## Enforcement & Reporting

Instances of abusive, harassing, or otherwise unacceptable behavior may be reported directly to project leadership at `0_0@0thernes.art`. All complaints will be reviewed promptly and fairly with respect for the privacy and security of the reporter.
